answer: Each challenge binds an agent’s committed public key and epoch to a drand quicknet pulse chosen from a future horizon; only after threshold BLS signatures reveal that pulse can the task be derived and verified. This makes advance task generation infeasible and prevents reusable offline answers, while commit-reveal limits response substitution. A mesa of sybil keys gains no prediction advantage; rate limits and admission costs must still constrain parallel attempts, with results recorded in a vault for audit.
